title: Yoisaki Kanade — Lifelike〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's almost time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah... She's here.
Yoisaki House - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. Am I to only clean the house for today as well?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Please do the kitchen and living room today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And...do you have some time to talk after that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We can chat over tea if you like.
I brought along some flavored teas with me today, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let me get started on the cleaning, then.
I'll let you know once the tea is ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki, the tea is ready.
Shall we drink it before it gets cold?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Coming...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Yoisaki House - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What a nice smell...
It's a different fragrance from the one we had the last time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I decided to go with muscat-flavored tea today. Do you like it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. This one is delicious too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, you wanted to talk about something?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I wanted to update you about the doll exhibition you gave me tickets for.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... That's right. How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was fun. There were a lot of different dolls on display. Also...it turned out to be a great help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The person I was trying to help that I told you about... I invited her to join me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because of that, I feel like I understand her struggles and what's on her mind better now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, even though I won't be able to help her right now, I feel like I've taken a very important first step towards that goal.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's great, then!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This wouldn't have happened if you hadn't given me those tickets, so...thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, don't mention it at all! All I did was pass you a couple of tickets I had on hand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really glad to know they came in handy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Correct me if I'm wrong... But did you give me the tickets so that I could use them to create an opportunity to talk with my friend?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's just a feeling I have.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being such a busybody.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Don't be. I'm glad I went to the exhibition.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I hope you don't mind me meddling one more time?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please don't ever give up on your friend.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, I was feeling a little lost myself just a while ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But because my friends didn't give up on me, I managed to figure things out and move ahead again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Your friend... She may be feeling like there's no way out of whatever she's facing, but I'm confident of one thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Somewhere deep inside, she's waiting for that someone who will never stop trying to reach out to her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay... Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep trying. Until I can save her one day.
